x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2015-01-01)
  and date <= (2026-08-31)
  and full text has (
    (
      stemmed "AI data center"
      or stemmed "AI data centre"
      or stemmed "cloud computing facility"
      or stemmed "data center"
      or stemmed "data centre"
      or stemmed "edge data center"
      or stemmed "edge data centre"
      or stemmed "high performance computing"
    )
    and (
      stemmed "carbon-aware"
      or stemmed "clean energy matching"
      or stemmed "renewable energy matching"
      or stemmed "renewable integration"
      or curtailment
    )
    and (perspective or review or survey)
  )
x_query.url: /works?filter=from_publication_date:2015-01-01,to_publication_date:2026-08-31,fulltext.search:%22AI data center%22|%22AI data centre%22|%22cloud computing facility%22|%22data center%22|%22data centre%22|%22edge data center%22|%22edge data centre%22|%22high performance computing%22,fulltext.search:%22carbon-aware%22|%22clean energy matching%22|%22renewable energy matching%22|%22renewable integration%22|curtailment,fulltext.search:perspective|review|survey&per_page=10
